info.title: Seed Certification API
info.description: API Gateway for Seed Certification System with Zero Trust Architecture using Hyperledger Fabric blockchain, IPFS storage, and Keycloak authentication

tags.name: Identity
tags.description: User identity management - registration, login, and blockchain enrollment

tags.name: Seed Batches
tags.description: Seed batch management and certification operations

tags.name: Documents
tags.description: Document management - IPFS retrieval, download, and integrity verification

get.description: Returns health status of all services (Blockchain, IPFS, Redis Queue)
Check if service is ready to accept traffic

post.description: Creates a new user in Keycloak IDP. This is the first step of the registration flow. After registration, user should login to get access token, then call /enroll to create blockchain identity.
Authenticates user and returns Keycloak access token. Use this token in Authorization header for other API calls.
Combined endpoint that registers user in Keycloak and automatically enrolls them in Fabric CA. This creates both the IDP identity and blockchain identity in one step.

post.summary: Enroll user identity in Fabric CA
post.description: Registers the authenticated user with Fabric CA and creates wallet identity. Should be called after user registers/logs in via Keycloak. The CA will generate a private key and certificate for the user.

get.description: Check if the authenticated user has a Fabric identity in the wallet

post.description: Refresh the user's certificate (re-enrollment). Use this when certificate is about to expire.
Revoke the user's certificate. Admin only operation.

get.description: List all user identities in the wallet. Admin only operation.

get.summary: Get seed batches owned by current user
get.description: Retrieve list of seed batches created by the currently logged-in producer. Only returns batches where the producer_keycloak_id matches the authenticated user's ID.

403.description: Forbidden - producer role required or user identity not enrolled

get.description: Retrieve list of all seed batches from blockchain

post.description: Create a new seed batch with document upload (Producer role required)

seedClass.description: Seed class classification (BS=Breeder Seed, BD=Foundation Seed, BP=Stock Seed, BR=Extension Seed)

qtyBaseUnit.description: Unit of measurement for the declared quantity (GRAM=Gram, KG=Kilogram, TON=Ton, BIJI=Seeds/Pieces, BATANG=Stems/Plants)

get.description: Retrieve detailed information about a specific seed batch
Retrieve complete transaction history of a seed batch from blockchain

post.description: Submit seed batch for certification (Producer role required)
Record field inspection results with photo (Field Inspector role required)

inspectionResult.example: Hasil inspeksi lapangan menunjukkan kondisi tanaman benih dalam keadaan baik dan sesuai standar

testedSampleQty.description: Quantity taken for quality testing (non-negative, physically removed from distributable stock)

certifiedQty.description: Quantity certified by field inspector (must be positive, cannot exceed declared quantity)

photo.description: Inspection photo or document (JPEG, PNG, PDF, Word)

post.description: Evaluate field inspection results (Chief Inspector role required)

evaluationNote.example: Evaluasi menunjukkan hasil inspeksi lapangan sudah sesuai dengan standar sertifikasi benih

post.description: Issue seed certification (LSM Head role required)

certNumber.description: Official certificate number issued by authority (5-50 characters)

certifiedQuantity.description: Certified quantity (must be positive, cannot exceed declared quantity)

post.description: Record seed distribution to farmers (Producer role required)

destinationAddress.example: Jl. Pertanian No. 123, Bandung, Jawa Barat 40115

evidence.description: Evidence document (PDF, JPEG, PNG, Word) - optional

get.description: Retrieve and stream a document from IPFS by its CID. The document content is streamed directly to the client with appropriate content-type headers. This endpoint is public since documents are immutable and verified by CID.

parameters.name: cid
parameters.description: IPFS Content Identifier (CID) of the document

Content-Disposition.description: Inline display with CID as filename

X-IPFS-CID.description: The IPFS CID of the document

get.description: Download a document from IPFS with a specified filename. Use the optional filename query parameter to set the download filename. This endpoint is public since documents are immutable and verified by CID.

parameters.name: cid
parameters.description: IPFS Content Identifier (CID) of the document

parameters.name: filename
parameters.description: Optional filename for the downloaded file

X-IPFS-CID.description: The IPFS CID of the document

get.description: Retrieve metadata about a document stored in IPFS, including file size and SHA256 hash. This endpoint is public since metadata is non-sensitive.

parameters.name: cid
parameters.description: IPFS Content Identifier (CID) of the document

post.description: Verify the integrity of a document by comparing its SHA256 hash with an expected hash. Can either provide the expected hash directly, or provide batchId and docType to fetch the hash from blockchain metadata. This endpoint is public for transparency and verification purposes.

400.description: Invalid CID format or missing required fields

post.summary: Public document verification with file upload
post.description: Public endpoint for verifying document authenticity by uploading a file and comparing its hash with the document stored in IPFS. This endpoint is designed for QR code scanning verification flow where the CID is provided as a query parameter. If verification passes, returns the associated seed batch certification data from blockchain.

parameters.name: cid
parameters.description: IPFS Content Identifier (CID) of the document to verify against. This is typically obtained from scanning a QR code on the certificate.

file.description: The document file to verify (PDF, DOC, DOCX, XLS, XLSX, JPG, PNG). Max size: 10MB

200.description: Document verification result with batch data if verified

400.description: Invalid CID format, missing CID, or missing file

get.summary: Public certificate verification via QR Code
get.description: Public endpoint for verifying seed certification certificates via QR Code scanning. Validates certificate number against batch ID and returns certificate status (VALID/REVOKED/EXPIRED/NOT_FOUND), issuer information, and document fingerprint. This is designed for public verification flow where users scan QR codes on certificate labels.

parameters.name: batch
parameters.description: Batch ID that the certificate should belong to

400.description: Missing certificate number or batch ID

isDelete.description: Indicates if this is a delete operation

username.description: Unique username (3-30 chars, alphanumeric and underscore)

message.example: User registered successfully. Please login to get access token, then call /enroll to create blockchain identity.

accessToken.description: JWT access token for API calls

hasIdentity.description: Whether user has a Fabric identity

sha256Hash.description: SHA256 hash of the file content

cid.description: IPFS Content Identifier of the document to verify

expectedHash.description: Expected SHA256 hash to compare against (optional if batchId and docType provided)

batchId.description: Seed batch ID to fetch expected hash from blockchain (optional)

docType.description: Document type in the batch to verify (optional, used with batchId)

valid.description: Whether the document integrity is valid

calculatedHash.description: SHA256 hash calculated from IPFS content

expectedHash.description: Expected SHA256 hash used for comparison

verified.description: Whether the uploaded document matches the stored document

hash.description: SHA256 hash of the stored document

uploadedHash.description: SHA256 hash of the uploaded file (only shown if verification failed)

storedHash.description: SHA256 hash of the stored document (only shown if verification failed)

batchData.description: Seed batch certification data (only included if document is verified and associated with a batch)

certificate.description: Certificate details if batch is certified

certNumber.description: The certificate number that was verified

issuer.description: Information about certificate issuer (only included for valid certificates)

revokedAt.description: Revocation date (only included if certificate is revoked)

revokeReason.description: Reason for revocation (only included if certificate is revoked)

documentFingerprint.description: Document fingerprint for additional file verification

cid.description: IPFS Content Identifier of the certificate document

sha256.description: SHA-256 hash of the certificate document
